shiftLock.slot: Center console storage bin — small access HOLE just below the media hub connections (USB/power ports). Open the center console storage lid. Locate the hole on the front wall of the bin, below the media hub. Insert a thin screwdriver or key to press the brake-shift interlock switch.
steps: Turn ignition to ON (press start button WITHOUT foot on brake for accessory mode).
Open the center console storage lid.
Locate the small access hole in the front wall of the storage bin, just BELOW the media hub/USB connections.
Insert a thin flathead screwdriver or key into the hole.
Press and HOLD the brake-shift interlock switch inside the hole.
The shift buttons on the instrument panel will FLASH — this indicates override mode is active.
While still holding the override switch, press the N (Neutral) button on the instrument panel.
Release the override button.
Vehicle is now in Neutral for towing.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood.
Once 12V power is restored, use the console hole override method OR shift normally.
If 12V cannot be restored: use the console hole method — it works without full electrical power.
AWD models: flatbed preferred.
TRANSFER CASE: must be shifted to 2WD/2H before towing. IF BATTERY IS DEAD: jump battery FIRST, shift TC to 2WD, then disconnect. If TC cannot be shifted: FLATBED ONLY.

tow.method: 4WD models: transfer case to 2H, then wheel-lift from front (rear drive wheels roll). RWD: lift from front. Flatbed strongly preferred for all configurations.
notes: ELECTRONIC TC requires 12V power. Jump battery first if dead.
If TC cannot be confirmed in 2WD, USE FLATBED.
Very heavy vehicle — confirm tow truck capacity before lifting.

battery.location: Under hood, passenger side near windshield base
battery.jumpPoints: Under hood — standard red (+) / black (−) terminals

alerts.warning: Transfer case to 2H before towing. Flatbed strongly preferred.
alerts.notes: 4WD Torque on Demand: transfer case must be in 2H before wheel-lift tow.

issues.title: Override Button Hidden Below Media Hub
issues.detail: The shift interlock override is NOT at the base of the shifter. It is a small hole BELOW the USB/media hub in the console storage bin. Many operators look at the shifter base and cannot find it. Look inside the bin, below the ports.

issues.title: 2023+ Navigator: Console Override Method May Not Work
issues.detail: Verified by tow operators in the field: the 2023+ Navigator L does NOT have a functioning console override hole. The manual is reportedly incorrect. Emergency method: crawl under the vehicle to the left side of the transmission. Remove the bolt holding a spring-loaded lever. Use a bungee cord or strap to pull the lever toward the REAR of the vehicle and hold tension. This releases the park pawl. Source: Lincoln Forums (2024), confirmed by tow operators.

shiftLock.slot: Column-mounted shifter — slot on the STEERING COLUMN, typically at the base of the column lever housing.
steps: Turn ignition to ON (key to Run position).
Column shifter: locate the shift lock override slot at the BASE of the column shifter housing.
Insert a thin flathead screwdriver into the slot.
Press firmly and hold.
Press the brake pedal firmly.
Move the column lever from Park to Neutral.
Remove tool.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood, driver side near firewall.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.

shiftLock.slot: Small plastic cap near the gear selector base on the center console.
steps: Turn ignition to ON (key to Run — do not start).
Locate shift lock cap near selector base on center console.

Remove tool and replace cap.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
